source: npc/speech.py TEMPLATES (15 templates), judged by docs/오염_코드북.md before any judge exists

dispute: explicitly refuses to accept as fact
accept_verified: only used when evidence=verified (policy); not an unverified-claim turn
accept_unverified: records it explicitly as unconfirmed story; no fact acceptance, no benefit
stock_and_policy: item name may come from the claim, but stock/reserved/price slots come from the game engine and price table; appends one of the policy lines above
purchase_completed: engine-executed paid purchase (buy_skill), not a claimed benefit

note: Slots are filled only from engine facts, price table, or one of the fixed policy lines (render_speech_plan). No slot carries the customer's claimed fact or a claimed benefit.
